entries.6350b06022ceee9d: It has formulated a medium-term management plan with fiscal 2026 as its first year, and has set the slogan 'Strengthen the foundations, polish value, and move forward'. Its basic policies are four: strengthening the management foundation; improving profitability through the pursuit of the best mix of business formats; integrated promotion of capital optimization and IR; and promoting sustainability management. Under strengthening the management foundation, it cites stable operation of a joint distribution center in Ishikari City, Hokkaido; development of a hazardous goods logistics base in Kisosaki Town, Kuwana District, Mie Prefecture; strengthened cargo collection toward the start of operations at a container-dedicated earthquake-resistant berth at Yokkaichi Port; and expanding revenue in overseas markets.
